# Structure and Ranks
## Executive track Rank is earned by time in the role and shows on your ID as a WYC paygrade.
- [bold]WYC1 Trainee[/bold]: new office worker. - [bold]WYC2 Junior Executive[/bold]: 5 hours as an office worker. - [bold]WYC3 Executive[/bold]: 15 hours. - [bold]WYC4 Senior Executive[/bold]: 25 hours. - [bold]WYC5 Executive Specialist[/bold]: Corporate Liaison. - [bold]WYC6 Executive Supervisor[/bold]: Corporate Liaison with 25 hours in the role. - [bold]WYC7 Assistant Manager[/bold]: Corporate Assistant. - [bold]WYC8 Division Manager[/bold]: leads small sites. On large sites, heads a division under the Chief Executive. - [bold]WYC9 Chief Executive[/bold]: leads large sites.
Which leadership a site gets is up to the map. On a site without a manager, the Corporate Liaison is the senior corporate employee and runs the office.
## Legal track Legal Specialists (WYC5L) and Legal Supervisors (WYC6L) advise the office on contracts, colony law and liability. They don't give orders to the executive track.
## Divisions Managers claim a division at the start of the shift. The division sets their kit and what they answer for: Special Services, Corporate Relations, Communications, PMC Dispatch, Research and Development, Economics, and Personal Protection.
## Science The Lead Researcher runs corporate research and answers to the senior corporate employee. Scientists rank up to Associate. Research is the corporation's main source of income, so protect it.
## Who may use what - The corporate console needs [bold]WYC5 or above[/bold]. - The corporate Overwatch console is rank-locked the same way. - Withdrawal needs [bold]WYC6 or above[/bold]. - Work terminals are open to any corporate ID.
